about: The editor's running notebook of ongoing storylines. At most 15 threads.

threads.status: Entered administration 25 Nov under AlixPartners (600 stores, 10k-12k jobs at risk); Commons BIST chair Liam Byrne wrote 26 Nov recalling Gordon Brothers' Mark Newton-Jones (noon 27 Nov deadline) and seeking non-insolvency assurances.
USTR proposed 15-35% tariffs on 14 trading partners on 25 Nov (China 0-20% or 40% fallback); written comments close 5 Jan 2027, public hearing starts 25 Jan 2027.

Anthropic's Luke Sernau and Claude cut Lean proof 99.5% to 76k compact / 300k readable lines on 25 Nov (Apache 2.0); passed all six Lean checkers at MIT and Waterloo by 26 Nov; full human paper still pending.

threads.topic: Developer platform rules and orbital AI compute
threads.status: FCC granted conditional licence 25 Nov for SpaceX's 1m-satellite Starmind AI data centres (debris waiver deferred); Google Play requires trader declarations by 1 Feb 2027 and global home-address display from 1 Mar 2027.
42 US states and DC moved to block 1 Dec bankruptcy auction of 21m users' private chats (2.1m minors) to Delaware entity Smirks and Pangs Acquisition LLC.
FIA cut Williams aero testing 1.5% and fined Alpine on 25 Nov; Bearman re-signed 26 Nov; drivers met stewards/FIA in Qatar 26 Nov over 2026 penalty consistency ahead of FP1-FP2 on 27 Nov.
McLaren trails Red Bull by 9 points for third in Constructors' Championship entering Lusail (27-29 Nov, 27-lap tyre stint cap); Norris confirmed pre-weekend review of 2025 Qatar strategy error.
Eisenkot clinched deals with Yisrael Beytenu and Democrats (36 of 61 seats) on 26 Nov with reported Haredi draft-exemption concessions as B'Yachad talks cancelled; mandate expires 6 Dec.

Trump deployed an extra aircraft carrier and warned on 26 Nov US would hit Pickaxe Mountain near Natanz if strikes resume; Kuwait drone strike killed two Italian Rheinmetall technicians on 26 Nov (Iran denied).
Trump altered Rutte NATO joint statement on 26 Nov to warn Ukraine as well as Russia before 2 Dec NATO talks; EU leaders pushed decision on €45bn 2027 Ukraine loan and 2028-2034 budget to 17-18 Dec.

threads.topic: UK winter pressures and NHS flu spike
threads.status: Ofgem raised Jan-Mar 2027 cap 26% to £2,166; UKHSA week 48 data (26 Nov) showed England flu admissions up 79% to 8.98 per 100k as NHS trusts declared critical incidents and Mackey urged masks.

threads.topic: UK cyber policy and broadcast rules
threads.status: UK National Cyber Action Plan delayed again from mid-Nov to 9 Dec; Ofcom published final Media Act 2024 Smart TV prominence code on 26 Nov covering 15 platforms.

Irish EU presidency proposed 'Made in Europe' car assembly partner status for UK without Chinese EV tariff alignment; EU ministers consider text on 3 Dec; European Partnerships Bill due before Christmas.

threads.topic: Nvidia leadership, export curbs and AI hardware
threads.status: Nvidia paused AI server shipments via Dell and Supermicro to Malaysia, Singapore, Thailand and Indonesia on 26 Nov amid US remote-access rules; S&P put Nvidia's AA rating on CreditWatch Negative on 25 Nov.

Anthropic detailed zero-downtime Python-to-Rust Messages API migration on 25 Nov (-70% CPU, -80% memory, -20% TTFT) via shadow-traffic agent loops; Amodei rejected claims of surrendering human control.
